name: kops
description: A read-only kubectl MCP server for AI assistants. The kubectl verb is hardcoded in each tool (get/describe/logs/events) and user input only fills argument values — no mutation path even with malicious input, and Secret/ConfigMap values are never returned (metadata only). Returns structured JSON, plu
